author: Bobby Grayson
description:
Despite the general switch away from mmap, testing revealed they are still significantly faster when searching a small number of files.

Sources:
- ca058d7: 'I thought plain read had usurped them, but when searching a very small number of files, mmaps can be around 20% faster on Linux. It would be really unfortunate to leave that on the table.'
title: Mmap still 20% faster for single-file searches on Linux
